_doc: Cross-lane identity. sprite_ref locks the look (passed to mflux-generate-flux2-edit via --image-paths), voice_ref locks the voice (5-15s of clean speech, passed to the cloning model). Either may be null: a null sprite_ref falls back to text-only generation, a null voice_ref falls back to the archetype's stock voice. description is repeated verbatim on every sheet — it is what holds identity together within a generation.

dawn-priest.description: a compact young dawn sanctuary priest, warm brown skin, swept chestnut hair, a small ivory forehead band with an amber sunstone, broad short teal shoulder mantle with gold piping, ivory split knee-length tunic, amber stole with a simple rising-sun emblem, brown belt with one small closed prayer book at the left hip, dark leggings and large leather boots fully visible below the tunic, holding in the right hand a slender wooden crozier with a brass open sun arch and one suspended amber crystal; friendly determined face, sturdy two-and-a-half-head chibi proportions, simple clearly separated limbs

elf-druid.description: a female wood elf druid with long braided auburn hair, green hooded cloak worn up, leather bracers, holding a gnarled wooden staff topped with a glowing acorn

demon-hunter.description: a lithe demon hunter with a blindfold over the eyes, dark leather armour, twin warglaives, tattered green cape

gnoll-shaman.description: a hunched hyena-headed gnoll shaman with bone fetishes braided into its mane, patchwork hide robe, carved totem staff

gnoll.description: a hunched hyena-headed gnoll warrior with matted fur, scavenged iron armour plates, notched cleaver

sporeling.description: a small grumpy mushroom monster with a red spotted cap, stubby legs and tiny angry eyes

imp.description: a small red-skinned imp with stubby horns, bat wings and a barbed tail, grinning

dracthyr.description: a bipedal dragonkin with bronze scales, small folded wings, ridged brow and a tail

dragon.description: a stocky green dragon with a heavy jaw, short horns and leathery wings

polar-hermit.description: a stocky bipedal polar bear wrapped in a thick fur-lined hooded cloak, frost crusted on his fur, leaning on a long wooden ice-fishing spear, standing idle

sea-guardian.description: a massive immortal guardian shark with a compact powerful silhouette, dark blue-gray back, pale underside, tall scarred dorsal fin, broad jaws, old pale scars and subtly luminous cyan eyes

sea-guardian-up.description: a massive immortal guardian shark with a compact powerful silhouette, dark blue-gray back, pale underside, tall scarred dorsal fin, broad jaws, old pale scars and subtly luminous cyan eyes, seen directly from above with its nose pointing straight up

sea-guardian-down.description: a massive immortal guardian shark with a compact powerful silhouette, dark blue-gray back, pale underside, tall scarred dorsal fin, broad jaws, old pale scars and subtly luminous cyan eyes, seen directly from above with its nose pointing straight down
